composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Draw Conan Edogawa in a plain cream sweater over a blue shirt, with his hair tuft and round glasses immediately recognizable. He tilts his head a few degrees as if listening, while both eyes remain visible through clear lenses. Keep his child proportions, small shoulders, and youthful expression intact. Use hand-drawn ink contours with a few lively pressure changes and broad muted-blue background washes. His mouth is a small interested smile, and the lens highlights sit only at the outer edges. No gadgets, bow tie mechanism, or lettering. Frame the portrait closely enough that the face carries the entire composition. Give both visible irises soft violet Rinnegan rings with a clear dark pupil and bright catchlights. Keep the rings fine and contained so the gaze remains warm and readable. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
